name: Value4Capital (V4C)
decision_note: Lower mid-market buyout manager focused on Poland/Romania/CEE (offices Luxembourg, Warsaw, Bucharest); final close of V4C Poland Plus Fund II at EUR 127.8m in January 2026; private equity, not VC, and no Czech office.

evidence.quote: We invest between € 7 - 15 million in buyout and growth transactions.

Value4Capital (“V4C”), a lower mid-market private equity manager focused on Poland and Central and Eastern Europe, today announced the final closing of its V4C Poland Plus Fund II (“Fund II”) at EUR 127.8 million.
Value4Capital today completed its acquisition of a majority stake in Elocity, a leading Polish technology provider to EV charging station operators, fleet managers and EV drivers.
Our main focus are service-oriented businesses.

analyst_notes: Quotes e2 and e4 come from the news listing page (https://www.value4capital.com/news), whose items carry their own dates (final close item dated January 14, 2026; Elocity completion item dated June 16, 2026); the individual article pages load their body via JavaScript, so the listing is used. Fund II first close EUR 110m on 2024-07-22, final close EUR 127.8m (headline 'EUR 128 million'). Earlier funds: V4C Poland Plus Fund (2017, EUR 91m), V4C Eastern Europe (2006, EUR 156m, fully exited). No Czech office (Luxembourg GP, Warsaw and Bucharest offices); CVCA profile (2020) lists the Czech Republic among target countries. Main focus: service-oriented businesses (generalist). Luxembourg/Polish entity registry numbers not looked up.
